_comment: Dachshund Howitzer (enemies.md; art-bible.md Sizes: 64x32 side view on a 72x48 canvas). The .blend is generated by model.py (tools/build.d/60-sprites.sh) into assets/gen/blend/dach/. Frames are Blender frame numbers of each action (constant interpolation: one pose per frame). Windup is one held pose (enemies.md: 2 identical frames).
